name: mantaprint-hub
changelog: Fix: Admin > Scanner no longer offers the HP plugin upload after the plugin is installed; the row shows an Installed pill instead.

Drivers & devices: steps that need several files (HP plugin .asc + .run, HP LaserJet .dl per model, ScanSnap .nal per scanner) show one row per file with its own upload button and a check mark once it is on the hub.
Fix: uploading the HPLIP plugin's .asc signature before the .run failed with 'Upload failed' (its folder did not exist yet).
